_doc: Per-repo config for .claude/hooks/*. TypeScript (npm, tsconfig.json includes src/**/*.ts). The repo has no formatter or ESLint config, so the edit hook only type-checks the project the way CI's `npm run build` does (tsc, no emit). The Stop hook runs `npm test` (vitest run), as CI's build-test job does; CI also runs test:integration, desktop, Rust and Docker jobs.
